detailed_description:
The target video is a live-action, cinematic martial-arts fight sequence set on an open flat dirt training ground under natural daylight, with the camera holding a continuous medium shot from a 45-degree right-side angle, tracking <Subject 1> as the two fighters exchange rapid combat.

[Shot 1] The scene opens on a bare open training ground. <Subject 1>, Gao Lao in a white tank top and black shorts, stands on the right side of the frame facing left toward <Subject 2>, Han Li in a light grayish-green linen martial arts outfit with long black hair in a silver-crowned topknot. At 00:00.000, Gao Lao feints a left jab, then snaps a fast low right shin kick into Han Li's left thigh; Han Li lifts his left knee to check and absorb the kick on his shin. At 00:00.500, Han Li counters immediately with a quick left straight punch toward Gao Lao's face; Gao Lao turns his head aside, the punch grazing his cheek. Gao Lao immediately drives a right uppercut swinging upward toward Han Li's jaw. At 00:01.000, Han Li tilts his head back to dodge the uppercut, then snaps a right straight punch into Gao Lao's solar plexus; Gao Lao grunts and absorbs the blow, his abdomen contracting. At 00:01.500, Gao Lao clamps his left hand around Han Li's punching wrist, yanks him forward, and drives a short left elbow into Han Li's right ribs. At 00:02.000, Han Li twists away from the elbow strike, spins his body a full 360 degrees, and delivers a spinning back kick with his right heel driving into Gao Lao's midsection; Gao Lao raises both forearms and blocks, pushed back one step by the impact. At 00:03.000, Gao Lao recovers his stance and surges forward, launching a leaping knee strike toward Han Li's chest; Han Li sidesteps sharply to his right at the last instant, the knee passing beside him. At 00:04.000, as Gao Lao's leaping knee sails past, Han Li shoves both palms against Gao Lao's back; Gao Lao stumbles forward off-balance, then spins his body around rapidly to face Han Li again, his glasses askew. At 00:05.000, Gao Lao unleashes a three-punch flurry: a left hook, a right hook, then another left hook; Han Li ducks and weaves under the first two punches, then catches the third left hook on his right forearm. At 00:06.000, Han Li pulls the caught arm to unbalance Gao Lao forward, then snaps a right front push kick into Gao Lao's midsection; Gao Lao bends forward from the impact, winded. At 00:07.000, Han Li raises his right leg overhead and brings his heel crashing down in an axe kick toward Gao Lao's upper back; Gao Lao drops to one knee and rolls forward to evade the descending heel. At 00:07.500, Gao Lao rolls through and springs up into a low crouch directly behind Han Li, sweeping his right leg low across the ground at Han Li's planted left leg. At 00:08.000, Han Li hops over the low sweep, rotates his body in mid-air, and delivers a descending hammerfist punch as he lands; Gao Lao pushes off his hands and rolls backward one body length to escape the strike. At 00:09.000, both fighters rise to their feet and face each other across the training ground, breathing heavily in a tense standoff, their glares locked. The camera continues to hold the medium shot from the 45-degree right-side angle through the final frame at 00:10.000.

overall_soundscape: Faint open-air wind ambience carries across the training ground throughout. Rapid whooshing sounds accompany every kick, punch, and spinning motion. Sharp cracking and thudding impacts ring out as shins, fists, elbows, and heels connect with blocking limbs and bodies, followed by the scuff of feet on dirt and the slap of palms against fabric. Heavy breathing and sharp exertion grunts rise from both fighters, with fabric rustling and the friction of sandaled and shod feet on the ground.

non_diegetic_music: A driving martial-arts percussion score at a fast tempo, featuring heavy taiko-style drums and rapid cymbal swells that intensify with each strike, sustaining high rhythmic energy through the final standoff.

<Subject 3> is the night-market environment in <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>: a narrow 4-meter-wide alley in an old urban village at night, lined with stalls under corrugated iron awnings, tangled overhead power lines, wet asphalt with oily reflections, plastic tables and chairs, and warm orange neon lighting mixed with cool dark-blue ambient tones.
<Subject 4> is the old tricycle food cart in <Picture 5>: a rusty olive-green three-wheeled cart with a stainless-steel countertop, a worn wok, an oil bottle and seasoning jars on the counter, and faded white hand-painted characters on its side.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic 3D rendered style with cinematic depth-of-field, warm orange sodium-light illumination, and visible night steam rising over the cart.
[Shot 1] A wide shot holds <Subject 1>, the 30-year-old street-food chef with the chiseled face, left-brow scar and stained dark-grey apron, standing slightly right of center behind the stainless-steel counter of <Subject 4>, the olive-green tricycle cart at the mouth of the night-market alley of <Subject 3>. He faces toward the camera in a three-quarter front view, head bowed, wiping the counter with a rag, his eyes never leaving the worn wok; the wok, his hands and his lowered face stay the sharp focal point of the frame. From the left edge, <Subject 2>, the 45-year-old Michelin head chef with the slicked-back hair, gold wristwatch and white chef's jacket, enters in side view with his torso angled away from the camera so that he never faces the lens, walks up to the cart, slaps a thick stack of banknotes onto the oily counter with a heavy thud, then kicks the corner of a long table beside the cart so it tips with a scraping noise. <Subject 2> (S1) speaks in a slow, arrogant, nasal middle-aged male voice referenced from <Audio 1>, leaning his upper body toward <Subject 1> with his face turned to the chef's lowered head, each word deliberately separated, <d>[Chinese] 一夜了，钱还在这，机会最后一次。</d> He closes his mouth into a thin contemptuous line. <Subject 1> keeps wiping the wok without looking up; only his fingers pause for a moment on the rim, then continue. The two men in dark suits behind <Subject 2> stand as silent shapes in the left background. The camera slowly pushes in past the overturned table toward <Subject 1>'s lowered face and the wok, the final frame settling on the worn wok and his steady hand in sharp focus.

overall_soundscape:
Deep-night market ambience continues throughout the video: a low electric hum from the neon signs, the distant clatter of an empty stall being closed, the scraping kick of the table, and the soft hiss of oil still cooling on the wok.

non_diegetic_music:
A low, restrained string pad at a slow tempo with a faint urban pulse, starting thin and gaining a cold edge as the banknotes hit the counter, then holding steady without a swell.
